_what: When the Mac reader takes an accessibility snapshot, how it reads it and what it removes before anything leaves (read-data/snapshot-triggers.mjs; the event half is the Mac app's macos/App/ComputerReader.swift). `triggers` are the events that ask for one (each with its own debounce, and `periodic_seconds` for the timer). `throttle` spaces them: a global least gap and a per-app gap that doubles (up to `backoff_most`) while an app's snapshots come back unchanged and returns to normal when one changes. `skip_when` names facts that skip a snapshot (the Mac is locked, memory is under pressure). Every decision is counted by outcome so silence is never mistaken for nothing happening. `parsers` are per-app rows (app name part; which elements to select by role and label pattern; which fields to cut out with regular expressions) delivered as data like any capability; the first row matching the app is used, a row without `app_contains` is the generic one. `redact` are patterns removed from every field on the device, replaced by `replacement`.
